Now are we ready to start the apocalypse again?|'''Fallen Hazmat''' to the [[Fallen King]] in the Fallen Mode rework trailer}} }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Hazmat''' is an enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] and Fallen Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has a decent amount of health, and it has above average speed, 60% defense and multiple immunities. These immunities prevent it from being set on fire, prevent it from being stunned, only being slowed down by stuns, prevent it from being knocked back and prevent it from being frozen or chilled by freezing towers. ==Logbook Description== "''Fallen Hazmats were created after the curse had taken hold over the kingdom. Unlike the other Fallen, the Hazmats are manifestations of the curse itself. They are more violent and unpredictable than other Fallen, driven by a hunger to prove their worth. Despite their chaotic nature, they remain loyal to the Fallen King and constantly search for powerful enemies to fight and cursed artifacts to bring to their master.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Hazmat''' has black skin. It wears bluish-grey armor with a lock on its chest, covering up most of its body. Its helmet has two horns sticking out of its sides. ==Strategy== *Towers with decent DPS, such as the [[Militant]], [[Golden Soldier]], [[Ace Pilot]] or [[Brawler]] can be quite effective against this. **High DPS towers, like the [[Turret]], [[Minigunner]], [[Crook Boss]] or [[Accelerator]] can also fare well against this. *As this generally spawns in hordes, area of effect towers like the [[Tesla]], [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful against this. *Because of its immunities, knockback and freeze cannot be used to slow it down. **Stuns can still be used, but because of its [[Stun Immunity]] it will only be slowed down instead of fully stunned. **Various less commons stalls, like the confusion and poison slowdown from towers like the [[Saboteur]] are not affected by any of their immunities. *Because of its immunities, freeze and burn defense dropping towers cannot drop its defense. **This should not be a huge problem due to its low health. ==Gallery== {{Gallery|
